description: Defines the WebSocketEndpointLockManager class for managing WebSocket connection locks, including nested classes Waiter and LockReleaser, and methods for locking, unlocking, and testing lock states.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager
classes.description: Manages locks for WebSocket endpoints to enforce connection throttling as per RFC6455 4.1.2.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::Waiter
classes.description: Interface for objects waiting for an endpoint lock.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockReleaser
classes.description: RAII class that releases the lock on destruction.

methods.name: LockEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock on a WebSocket endpoint; returns status.

methods.name: UnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Releases the lock on a specified endpoint asynchronously.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the lock info map is empty (for testing).

methods.name: SetUnlockDelayForTesting
methods.description: Sets the delay before unlocking an endpoint, for testing purposes.
